question: Which railway station received the National Energy Conservation Award 2025 as the Best Performing Unit in the Transport Category (Railway Station)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Miyana Railway Station, Madhya Pradesh.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **Miyana Railway Station in Guna district, Madhya Pradesh, received the National Energy Conservation Award 2025 on National Energy Conservation Day.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• The **National Energy Conservation Award 2025** was presented to Miyana Railway Station.
 
• The station was recognised as the **Best Performing Unit in the Transport Category**.
 
• Energy-saving measures include **LED lighting, BLDC fans, and smart lighting systems**.
 
• These initiatives helped save **9,687 units of electrical energy**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• National Energy Conservation Award__

 __
 
• Conferred annually on National Energy Conservation Day.
 
• Recognizes outstanding achievements in energy efficiency.
 
• Awarded by the **Bureau of Energy Efficiency**.
 
 
 
• Bureau of Energy Efficiency__
 __
 
• Statutory body under the Ministry of Power.
 
• Promotes efficient use of energy across sectors.
 
• Implements policies for sustainable energy management.
 
 
 
• Energy-Efficient Technologies Used__
 
 
• LED lighting reduces power consumption and maintenance costs.
 
• BLDC fans consume significantly less electricity than conventional fans.
 
• Smart lighting systems optimize energy use through automated controls.
